Despite the v1.0 request, the response is a pure v0.3-flat envelope: kind:'task' at the top level (not nested under a 'task' key), lowercase state, {'kind':'text',...} parts -- confirmed the opposite mismatch from agent.co-legal.be (which always replies v1.0-style regardless of request dialect).
